verdict.rationale: Commenting on items is a fair question for a work-management platform like Wrike, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents inline comments anchored to specific text or images within an item's description. The closest items are an AI 'comment summary' feature, a visual canvas and file attachments, which are adjacent features and do not deliver inline description commenting.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can comment directly on specific text or images within an item's description
